identity.title: Incorrectly Placed Spent Fuel Assemblies in Unit 2 Spent Fuel Pool

cause.proximate_text: The root cause was the lack of specific guidance in the engineering standard used to calculate projected burn up values for compliance with Technical Specifications. As a result, the calculation preparer developed an incorrect calculation methodology... the preparer made an error in applying the correction factor, which resulted in projected burn up values for the four fuel assemblies being higher (non-conservative) than their actual values.
cause.theme: inadequate procedural guidance leading to calculation error

nodes.display_name: Engineering standard lacked specific guidance for burnup projection
nodes.description: The engineering standard used to calculate projected burn up values for compliance with Technical Specifications lacked specific guidance.

nodes.display_name: Calculation preparer developed incorrect burnup projection methodology
nodes.description: With no detailed instructions provided, the preparer developed an alternate method for calculating projected assembly burnup based on a correction factor.

nodes.display_name: Burnup augmentation factor incorrectly applied to entire operating history
nodes.description: This burn up augmentation factor was incorrectly applied to the burn up of the fuel assemblies over their entire operating history as opposed to just applying the augmentation factor to the current cycle burnup.

nodes.display_name: Error not caught during calculation preparation, review, or approval
nodes.description: The error was not caught during the preparation, review, or approval of the calculation.

nodes.display_name: Four fuel assemblies placed in SFP Region 3 despite insufficient measured burnup
nodes.description: On July 15, 2021, the spent fuel assemblies were placed into Region 3 following the July 2021 ISFSI Campaign, despite having lower measured burnup than the minimum requirement for Region 3 storage with borated stainless-steel poison rodlets.

nodes.display_name: Technical Specification 3.9.18 Action Statement entered / prohibited configuration in SFP
Relocate four non-complying fuel assemblies to acceptable location in Region 1
Revise engineering standard to require measured burnup and prohibit projection
Additional corrective actions per Corrective Action Program
